hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: McMoRan entered oil/gas derivative contracts in connection with 2007 oil and gas property acquisition for anticipated production 2008-2010. Contracts not designated as hedges for accounting purposes; mark-to-market treatment. All remaining derivative contract positions matured on December 31, 2010. No current positions as of December 31, 2012.
